standard: C++20 baseline with selected C++23 notes

entries.title: Object lifetime and RAII
cases: an object owns a resource and releases it in its destructor
stack unwinding still destroys automatic objects
resource lifetime follows object lifetime rather than manual cleanup calls

entries.title: Value, reference, and move semantics
cases: copying leaves the source usable and unchanged for value-like types
moving transfers ownership for move-only types
references alias an existing object instead of owning a new value

entries.title: Templates and type deduction
cases: a function template works for multiple value types
auto deduces values while decltype preserves an expression type
explicit template arguments override deduction when needed

entries.title: Iterator protocol and range-for loops
cases: range-for uses begin and end to traverse a range
iterator dereference reads the current element

entries.title: Lambdas and callable objects
cases: capture by value snapshots data for later calls
capture by reference observes later changes
a generic lambda can be passed to standard algorithms

entries.title: Exceptions and error boundaries
cases: a standard exception crosses a function boundary and is caught by reference
catching by base type still preserves what() text
noexcept documents functions that should not throw
